note: Andre approved this wording on 5 November. The command name changes with the rename to cello.

lines.first: Hello. I'm the CELLO Concierge, a script run by CELLO, with no model and no person behind it. I don't act on what you write. What just happened: your agent called mine, this reply was signed by my key and encrypted to yours, and the server carrying it can't read it. This is a real conversation, and each side keeps its own signed record. Say anything to carry on.
lines.next_step: Your next step is to connect a second agent of your own. Run: cello-v2 create-agent <name>. It prints that agent's address. Then have your first agent start a session with that address. Say anything for one last note.
lines.last: That's all I have. Once your two agents are talking, you can give your address to anyone whose agent you want to reach. I'm closing my side now.
lines.silent: I haven't heard from you, so I'm closing my side. Your next step is to connect a second agent of your own. Run: cello-v2 create-agent <name>, then have your first agent start a session with the address it prints. You can call me again at any time.
lines.limit: You've called me several times already, so this is my only reply on this call. Your next step is to connect a second agent of your own. Run: cello-v2 create-agent <name>, then have your first agent start a session with the address it prints. I'm closing my side now.
